William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Miscellaneous Epigrams

To Chloe’s breast young Cupid slyly stole

XV
T
O
 Chloe’s breast young Cupid slyly stole,
But he crept in at Myra’s pocket-hole.
